_comment: Israeli employers that hire DevOps / SRE / platform engineers. Generated by agents/scripts/build_company_directory.py from agents/scripts/candidates_israel.txt; the `ats` field is filled in from agents/config/ats-companies.json, which only ever contains boards verified live against a public ATS API. A null `ats` means the employer hires through its own careers site or a board the scanner does not read - the LinkedIn and Drushim sources still cover those.
